notes.title: Release time and prices
notes.notes:
I'm excited to tell you that ZeGame will be released roughly 4 hours after this post.
ZeGame will be $4.99 on steam with 10% off.
You will also be able to buy ZeGame on iOS and Android.
If you want to support charity by buying ZeGame, consider buying ZeGame via the humble store. You'll receive a steam key so you are still able to play ZeGame via steam.
If you want to support the developer of ZeGame. You can buy ZeGame via the official website.
